history.heading: Kanak heritage and colonisation
paragraphs: New Caledonia, a group of islands in the southwest Pacific, was settled about 3,000 years ago by the Lapita people, ancestors of the indigenous Kanak. James Cook named the main island in 1774 after Scotland (Caledonia).

France annexed New Caledonia in 1853 and used it as a penal colony until 1897. Nickel was discovered in 1864, and mining attracted settlers and workers. Kanak people were confined to reserves, and revolts in 1878 and 1917 were crushed.

history.heading: The independence question
paragraphs: In the 1980s, violent clashes between pro-independence Kanaks and loyalists, known as "les Événements", culminated in the 1988 Ouvéa cave hostage crisis. The Matignon Accords (1988) and Nouméa Accord (1998) brought peace and transferred powers. Three independence referendums in 2018, 2020 and 2021 rejected independence; the last was boycotted by pro-independence groups.
In May 2024, a proposed change to voting rules triggered deadly riots. In 2025 an agreement was negotiated proposing a "State of New Caledonia" within France, though it was contested by some groups.

culture.heading: Kanak and Caldoche cultures
paragraphs: The population is about 40 percent Kanak and about a quarter of European descent (Caldoches and metropolitan French), with Wallisians, Futunians, Asians and others. French is official, and around 28 Kanak languages are spoken.
The Tjibaou Cultural Centre, designed by Renzo Piano, celebrates Kanak culture. The lagoons of New Caledonia, surrounding one of the world's longest reefs, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

politics.heading: Special status
paragraphs: New Caledonia has a unique status within France as a "sui generis" collectivity, with its own Congress and government holding many powers. France retains control of defence, justice, security and currency. The UN lists it as a non-self-governing territory.

economy.heading: Nickel
paragraphs: New Caledonia holds a significant share of the world's nickel reserves, and mining and processing dominate exports. The nickel industry has been in crisis due to low prices and competition from Indonesia, and several plants have closed. The 2024 riots also caused heavy damage. Tourism and French transfers are important. The currency is the CFP franc.
